introduction.p: Sportsball is a game similar to basketball. There are three ways for a team to score points: a long field goal earns L points; a short field goal earns S points; and a penalty shot earns P points.
In the first half of one game, a team scored 24 penalty shots, 41 long field goals, and 45 short field goals. So they earned {24P+41L+45S} points.

statement.p: In the second half of the game, that same team scored 25 penalty shots, 43 long field goals, and 47 short field goals. How many points did they earn during the second half?
How many points did the team score in total?
